verdict.rationale: Orb documents threshold-based usage alerts, a credit-balance alert API, and tracking of accrued revenue before invoices, so the team-side core of the story is covered. It is unproven whether customers themselves can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time; the evidence describes alerts and accrual tracking but no customer-facing usage view. missing for 10: customer-facing real-time usage/cost portal or embed, documented current-cycle usage and cost query for the team, alert delivery details, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone

citations.quote: Trigger alerts at usage thresholds to power product-led growth.
This endpoint creates a new alert to monitor a customer's credit balance.
Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
